scope: all four pairs, all three saved training seeds, all three datasets; limited diagnostic cohorts, not exhaustive gradient validation or independent test

timing.planning_description: Approximately 3 h 45 min including startup on one RTX 4090; initial preflight and later independent/presentation review not part of the execution-phase timer.

interpretation: Effects depend strongly on the model used to optimize the diagnostic input; both predeclared origins must be considered. These limited model-selected counterfactuals do not establish natural robustness or architectural superiority.
limitations: diagnostic cohorts only: SHD* 40, SSC 70, ECG 30; only 8 repeat records and 4 optimized records per dataset
SLAYER sensitivities are surrogate derivatives; optimized labels held fixed do not guarantee unchanged semantic class
parent/variant-optimized selection is model/loss coupled; no causal or architectural superiority claim
ECG per-step targets, original all-zero vectors mapping to class 0 and model-step time units preserved
no independent official test, no exact Nature figure reproduction, no new model-weight training
source_high baseline remains separate; shared parents/records/random replicates are not independent seeds
Six-step greedy projection is not a global optimizer; ineffective attempts do not exclude other feasible diagnostic inputs.
ECG sensitivity is for record-mean supervised CE over its original valid temporal labels, not a per-class causal attribution.
next_step: Stage 8: synthesize the verified mechanism findings and report cost/activity with existing source-high performance evidence; do not launch new training or independent-test claims.
